title: Tiny, cute crystal ball
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="40%" cy="35%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e0f7ff"/>
      <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#7dd8f0"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#3a8fd4"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2a5fa8"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="shine" cx="35%" cy="30%" r="30%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="base" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#c9a84c"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8a6a1a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="baseShine" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f0d878"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b08e2e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="inner" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#b0d8ff" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#5ab8e8" stop-opacity="0.3"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#3a8fd4" stop-opacity="0.1"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- sparkles around the ball -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="22" r="1.5" fill="#aad8ff" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="18" r="1.2" fill="#c0e8ff" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="45" r="1.5" fill="#aad8ff" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="50" r="1" fill="#c0e8ff" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="25" cy="68" r="1.3" fill="#b0d8ff" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="70" r="1" fill="#c0e8ff" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="12" r="1.2" fill="#d0f0ff" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- crystal ball sphere -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="44" r="26" fill="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- inner mist -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="44" r="20" fill="url(#inner)"/>

  <!-- swirling mist inside -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="40" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#c8ecff" opacity="0.25" transform="rotate(-15 46 40)"/>
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="50" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#d8f4ff" opacity="0.2" transform="rotate(20 56 50)"/>

  <!-- main highlight -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="44" r="26" fill="url(#shine)" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- specific shiny spot top-left -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="32" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.55" transform="rotate(-30 40 32)"/>

  <!-- small secondary shine -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="30" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.85" transform="rotate(-30 38 30)"/>

  <!-- glowing rim on bottom right -->
  <path d="M 68 58 A 26 26 0 0 0 72 44" stroke="#8ae0ff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- pedestal base -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="18" ry="4" fill="#5a4410" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- base body -->
  <path d="M 34 70 Q 34 66 38 64 L 62 64 Q 66 66 66 70 L 64 76 Q 60 79 50 79 Q 40 79 36 76 Z" fill="url(#base)"/>

  <!-- base top rim highlight -->
  <path d="M 36 64 Q 42 62 50 62 Q 58 62 64 64" stroke="#f0d878" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- base front shine -->
  <path d="M 40 68 Q 44 72 50 73 Q 56 72 60 68" stroke="url(#baseShine)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- base bottom rim -->
  <path d="M 37 75 Q 42 78 50 78 Q 58 78 63 75" stroke="#d4b44a" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- little gem on base -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="69" r="2.5" fill="#ffd700" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="69" r="1.5" fill="#fff4b0" opacity="0.9"/>

  <!-- tiny sparkle on gem -->
  <circle cx="50.5" cy="68.3" r="0.6" fill="#ffffff"/>
</svg>
